import re
import sys

values = {}
assignment = re.compile(r"([a-zA-Z]+)\s*<-\s*([a-zA-Z]+|\d+)\s*;")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.fullmatch(line.strip())
    if match:
        name, source = match.groups()
        values[name] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
